decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits very close to the firm's core organic dairy and cheese know-how, so the firm can read its market results and refine it, and it still had its own page in 2019 after weaker launches were cut.

The spicy cheese line builds directly on established cheesemaking knowledge and organic milk supply, and its survival into 2019 with a dedicated page suggests the firm has absorbed what it learned and finds the line commercially viable.
The mild creamy soft cheese draws on existing soft-cheese competence, and unlike the washed-rind variant it stayed on the website with its own page, showing management judged it a fit worth keeping.
